US Envoys Witkoff and Kushner to Visit Russia and Ukraine for Peace Talks

Former US President Donald Trump announced that envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner would travel to Moscow and Kyiv to discuss a potential peace deal to end the war in Ukraine. The visits were planned for the weekend, with Moscow scheduled for Saturday and Kyiv for Sunday. This diplomatic mission aims to restart stalled peace negotiations between Russia and Ukraine. The announcement came as Russia escalated its strikes, with a drone hitting the headquarters of Ukraine's SBU security service in Kyiv. The exact nature of the proposal Witkoff and Kushner are carrying was not detailed.
